q: When should I book Inca Trail permits?
a: Permits for the Classic 4-day route sell out months ahead for peak season (May–September). Message us with your target month — we track availability and secure permits for our travelers when possible.

q: What is the difference between the Classic and Short Inca Trail?
a: The Short 2-day version enters through KM 104 and still reaches Machu Picchu with less camping. The Classic 4-day is the full trek with more altitude gain. Tell us your fitness level and we recommend the right route.

q: Do you include porters and camping equipment?
a: Most Inca Trail packages include guides, camping gear, meals on the trail, and Machu Picchu logistics. Exact inclusions vary by package — open any itinerary or ask us on WhatsApp for your dates.

q: Can you combine the Inca Trail with other regions in Peru?
a: Yes — many travelers add Lima, the Sacred Valley, Lake Titicaca, or the Amazon. We build custom multi-region itineraries with one English-speaking coordinator.
